I have verified everything needed. Let me compile my findings.

Key facts verified:

1. `--max-attempts` defaults to 2 (line 90), per-step spawn counter capped (line 324).
2. The per-step attempt counter is a local `spawns` Map keyed by step.id, reset per `workPlan` call (line 314, 322-323).
3. Retry-on-limit is opt-in via `--retry-on-limit` flag (line 94), with `--retry-minutes` default 30 (line 95) and `--max-retries` default 48 (line 96).
4. Limit detection regex (line 294) and structured signals (429, stop_reason, isError) (lines 295-297).
5. `msUntilReset` parses reset time, sanity-capped at 12h (lines 408-419).
6. Retry loop only retries `stopKind === 'limit'` and `retryOnLimit` (line 489); budget/failure stops break.
7. `recordAttempt` sets status done on pass, failed on fail (db.mjs 674-675).
8. The `n > maxAttempts` check happens BEFORE spawn (line 324), and the `after.status === 'failed' && n >= maxAttempts` check after (line 396).

Let me write the findings and verdict.FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#maxAttempts","claim":"Per-step spawn cap defaults to 2 and is set by --max-attempts; the counter is a per-workPlan local Map keyed by step.id, so it resets each time workPlan is (re)entered","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:90,314,322-323"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#attempt cap check","claim":"The cap is enforced BEFORE spawning: if n > maxAttempts the step is paused for a human and workPlan returns 'paused'","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:324"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#failed cap check","claim":"A second cap check after the attempt pauses when the step status is 'failed' and n >= maxAttempts","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:396"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#retryOnLimit","claim":"Retry-on-limit is opt-in via --retry-on-limit; without it a usage/rate-limit stop breaks the loop immediately","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:94,489"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#retryMinutes/maxRetries","claim":"--retry-minutes defaults to 30 and --max-retries defaults to 48 (≈24h safety cap)","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:95-96"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#limit detection","claim":"A limit stop requires a structured signal (HTTP 429, stop_reason matching the regex, or isError with result matching); a successful agent merely mentioning 'rate limit' does not stop the run","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:294-297"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#msUntilReset","claim":"When the limit message names a reset time, sleep targets just past it (2-min buffer); otherwise falls back to --retry-minutes; parses are sanity-capped at 12h","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:408-419"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recordAttempt","claim":"recordAttempt sets the step status to 'done' on verdict pass and 'failed' on fail/partial (failed is still retryable, not blocked)","evidence":"src/db.mjs:674-675"}]

VERDICT: pass — verified usage-limit detection, opt-in retry-on-limit sleep loop, and the per-step --max-attempts spawn cap in scripts/runner.mjs (with recordAttempt status semantics in src/db.mjs).
